propositions: Code review must select built-in and project criteria from the immutable CriteriaSnapshot, respecting effective disables, retuned parameters, applicability rules, and project DET inclusion instead of unconditional Round-A fan-in.
Code review must enforce positive authored usd_budget with unit shedding before execution, omit budget caps when unset, and reject zero budgets; shed and retained units must be recorded internally.

When one criterion call fails locally, independent criteria must continue executing; successes must survive; missing blocking-capable coverage returns INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists; advisory-only missing coverage may pass.

Code review must preserve authored code-review.yaml topology, base-reviewer summary/recommendations payload, per-overlay context overrides, model-ladder resolution, sequential scheduling, one-hop Round B, and absence of checkpoints.
Internal discovery trace must be persisted in the code-review journal/sidecar, never in the public review response or status projection, with exact call ids and order recorded.
Systemic configuration/provider setup failure and cancellation must stop remaining work with exact usage accounting and fail-safe behavior without signed or hollow pass verdicts.
